mapper.select: SELECT p.po_id, p.po_no, p.po_no AS order_id, p.branch_code, b.name AS branch_name, DATE_FORMAT(p.request_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place_order_detail d WHERE d.po_id = p.po_id) AS item_count, COALESCE((SELECT CAST(SUM(d.requested_qty) AS SIGNED) FROM place_order_detail d WHERE d.po_id = p.po_id), 0) AS total_qty, p.total_material_cnt, p.total_amount, p.reject_reason, p.status AS status_code, CASE p.status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN '전송' WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN '승인' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN '반려' ELSE '전송' END AS status, CASE p.status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN '전송' WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN '승인' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN '반려' ELSE '전송' END AS status_key, NULL AS detail_url, CASE WHEN p.status = 'PENDING' THEN NULL ELSE NULL END AS cancel_url FROM place_order p JOIN branch b ON b.branch_code = p.branch_code WHERE p.po_no = #{value}

SELECT pod.po_detail_id, pod.po_id, pod.material_code, m.material_name, pod.requested_qty, pod.approved_qty, pod.remaining_qty FROM place_order_detail pod JOIN material m ON m.material_code = pod.material_code JOIN place_order p ON p.po_id = pod.po_id WHERE p.po_no = #{value} ORDER BY pod.po_detail_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place_order (po_no, branch_code, status, total_material_cnt, total_amount, reject_reason) VALUES (#{poNo}, #{branchCode}, #{status}, #{totalMaterialCnt}, #{totalAmount}, #{rejectReason})

INSERT INTO place_order_detail (po_id, material_code, requested_qty, approved_qty, remaining_qty) VALUES
(#{poId}, #{detail.materialCode}, #{detail.requestedQty}, #{detail.approvedQty}, #{detail.remainingQty})
